title: Imitate Heavenly Lifestyles
body:
Dastoor yaa Sayyidee. Madad yaa Sayyidee. (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Rabbee Allah
Rabbun Allah, Rabbun Allah. Hasbun Allah, Hasbun Allah, Hasbun Allah
Subhaan Allah, Subhaan Allah, Subhaan Allah, Sultaan Allah. Subhaan Allah, Sultaan Allah.
Salli wa sallim wa barik yaa Rabbana ala habibika 'l-Mustafa. Zidhu yaa Rabbee `izzan wa sharafan nooran
wa surooran wa ridwaana wa sultaanan wa `ala man tabi`ahu min al-umam bi ihsaanin ila yawm addeenRabbana ija`alna minhum. Yaa ni`ma 'l-Mawla, yaa Rabbana. Yaa Rabbana. Anta Hasbuna. Anta
Waliyuna. Anta Mawlana. Wa ni`mal Mawla Anta yaa Rabbana wa ni`ma 'l-wakeel. Laa hawla wa laa
quwatta illa billahi 'l-`Aliyyu 'l-`Azheem. Huuuuuuu. A`oodhu billaahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem.
Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O our Attenders! As-salaamu `alaykum! Come and listen. All of us must listen, must follow, and must keep
heavenly orders. Try to be living ones, and don't be like the animal world's members. There are two kinds of
membership have just been granted to people living on this planet. Madad yaa Sultan al-Awliyaa.

Salafi `ulamas, Salaafiyoon! Isma`oo, listen and obey. You've never heard of two kinds of memberships on
this planet? There are so many things, and you are knowing nothing yawmun jadeed rizqun jadeed maa
yantahi hadhihi 'l-`uloom laysa min matala'ati 'l-kutub (a new day, new provision. These [inspired]
knowledges never end and these sciences are not what is read in books). It is not something that they are
making a weak servant to declare to all nations who are living on this planet. They are not leaving that weak
one to look to books and to address people, no. Therefore, you, including myself also, what is coming from
holy ones through heavenly ones and as much as they are opening for understanding, try to understand.
It may be repeated once or ten times until we may understand, because our lives need a base. Without a base,
our lives are going to be nothing! And as we are appointed by heavenly centers to be on this planet and to
establish our lives here, we have been ordered to make a base for our lives. Yes. That is something that people
must think about.
That is an ocean. Daily an opening is coming, and Man is needy to establish their lives on this planet.
Therefore, everyone's life is like a building, and a building needs a base. Without a base it is not building, no.
Chatchury is going to be without a base, foundation and base. It is chatchury, the language of jinns. He knows
chatchury (Mawlana Shaykh indicates someone in the association). Jewish people know. There must be a
base on it. That is the foundation for the lives of Mankind on this planet. We are in need of that, or our lives
are going to have no meaning, yes.
Therefore, heavenly ones are saying, "O People! Come and put a base or a foundation in this life." And that
foundation must be a strong one, not to be chatchury, and not to be a little bit shaking, and coming down.
That is not a building. We must establish our lives on this planet. And the project. YarhamukAllah
(someone sneezes). This foundation for Mankind on this planet has been sent through prophets from the
beginning up to the end to establish our lives. Yes. Every prophet came and was teaching people how they
should be in their lives, and that this life is temporary. Ayyaaman ma`doodaat, “A set number of days.” You
must understand, Salaafiyoon. Ayyaaman ma`doodaat is not only for the days of Holy Ramadan, but
ayyaaman ma`doodaat is only for the limited days for the lives of Mankind. First of all, the sign for the lives
of Mankind is that his days on this planet are ayyaaman ma`doodaat, a limited number of days. Yes, you
must understand and you must try to establish some basis that you will be on restfully, peacefully, and with

safety, bi kulli amaan, in all security, security and fearlessly.
And they are saying there are two kinds of Creation on this planet. One wing belongs to Mankind, and the
second wing belongs to all creatures that are on the level of animals. Mankind is only one, but in the animal
world there are countless kinds of animals and they haven't been given responsibilities. Therefore, their base
is simple, simple, very simple. But, Mankind who has been granted a responsibility by their Creator, the Lord
of Heavens, must look at themselves in this life, and how their positions will be in heavenly levels. Yes, we
must know, and we must learn. We must try to establish our lives on such a base that we can be saved by that
basis and no harm may come on ourselves, either from the animals' side or from the Heavens, yes.
O Salafi `ulamas! Are you teaching people to establish their lives on this planet? Are you teaching them or
not? You must teach people. If you are saying, “We are Salaafiyoon," say what is the real base for Mankind on
this planet. And when you are knowing, you must teach people is just asked from heavenly ones for
establishing. Yes. There are some establishing, strong ones, and some of them without a foundation, and
people may live in it. There are two kinds of living ones on this planet, one side is for Mankind who have been
granted a title from the Lord of Heavens to be deputies. You must say that there is a difference in that wing of
life here, and the second wing never have any responsibilities for anything, yes.
There is no blame on the animals' wing or animal world and what they are doing. No one can blame them,
but blame is coming on that wing that we are on! And the base of our lives must be as strong as possible, so
that you can be able to bring what it has been asked from Heavens. Therefore, prophets came to teach people
the important aim of why they are in this life. All prophets came as a teachers, teaching people their lifestyles.
Because we have been honored, our buildings must be on a heavenly foundation. The animal world is not in
need of a foundation because they are not going to be asked, and they are not carrying any responsibility.
Heavenly honor has just been granted for Mankind but the animals' wing for creatures are excused there.
They have no responsibility, and no honor. But Mankind has a responsibility and if they are bringing that
responsibility fully, they have been granted a full honor from the Heavens.
Therefore, now we are on this planet and we must look once again at the 21st century. Once again we must
look for what we are in Creation, and for what we have been created. Yes. Countless animals' life, animals'
world, countless creatures are in it, but the wing of Man's side is only one. What is most necessary for the

Children of Adam to look after? Therefore, we are saying there is coming a project from the Heavens for
establishing our honorable beings on this planet. That heavenly project is coming, and the prophets were
coming and teaching people, "O people, establish your lives according to that project.” If you are leaving that
heavenly project, you are going to be kicked away to the animals' wing side. Therefore, we are saying we are
in need of a base. And you can't be able to learn that base by thinking. That base that we are on, we are
building our heavenly project. It is just a grant coming from Heavens to ourselves, and we must take care.
O Salafi `ulamas! What are you saying? And there are so many kinds of people, some of them are interested
in heavenly projects, and others, maybe the majority are occupied by some projects that are going to be
similar to the lives of the animal world. What is that? Say, Salafi `ulamas, for the honor of Mankind, that
project that is 500 Maa jaa'a bihi 'n-nabi (s), (Mawlana Shaykh stands) tasharrafa wa takarram, “What the
Prophet (s) brought, [500 orders from Shari`ah] may he be honored and blessed.” (Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Our lifestyles just had been shown on that project, 500 kinds of honorable aspects have been granted to us.
Those who are keeping their buildings are just suitable for a heavenly life on Earth. That is Maa jaa'a bihi 'nnabi (s). This is what the Seal od Prophets (s) just came to teach all nations the heavenly project for
establishing their Eternal lives’ project. Second, there are 800 manhiyyun `anh, forbidden works, actions, or
efforts. That project is just signed by Shaytan and Shaytan's graduated people. Now, people are going to be on
two paths. What about you and your country, your people? On which wing are they working? Are they asking
to establish a heavenly project for themselves? They are in need of being on a base that is just supported by
the Heavens. Or else people are running on the shaytanic project, and people are running to establish
Shaytan's project here.
We are saying to mulook, shuyookh and presidents, those who have been granted an honor on people, what is
your life project or lifestyle? If you can say, "Our lifestyles are similar to a heavenly one,” you have been
saved. And honor that is granted from Heavens is coming on you and you are dressing in that honor. If not,
we are looking now through east and west and through the whole Muslim world and people, Muslims also,
they are running after a shaytanic project to act on it. Everything that the Muslim world is trying to build, to
do, is similar to unbelievers' projects, everything!
And we have a saying that if there is no wife for a man, he is majboor mana, he needs to wash his own clothes.

Now they are putting clothes in a machine and our people are putting in a machine. In old times women were
washing and putting like this, like this (makes movement with hips). Shari`ah is saying that if a man washes
clothes, no woman for him, he must make movement like a man does, not tashabbuh, imitation like women,
not like (sways hips). Shari`ah is so sensible for Muslims to keep the heavenly project that has been sent from
the Heavens to people. If anyone is going a different way:
•• •• •• •• ••••• ••••
faman shadhdha shudhdha fin-naari abadan, Who goes astray goes astray in the Fire, forever.
They are falling in Fire. Therefore, I am shouting at Salaafiyoon, why they are not making it clear to the
ummah, to people, how they should live, and how they should establish their lives? (In Islam there is no
allowance for Muslims to imitate non-Muslim people or their world and customs.)
Look, I am an old person and before 70 years ago I was visiting Haramayn Sharifayn, sharrafahum Allah Jala
wa a`alaa, the time of shareefs, so humble and everything was so simple. When you were coming in it and
you were feeling something carrying you to those holy places. Our souls were like fish in the sea. Now I can't
go. I am looking at the TV or videos and they are showing Haramayn Shareefayn, and they just changed
everything! You can't find any step that is for Islam, but it is just an imitation of western people. And I don't
like to go there now. I don't like to, but people who haven't been there, they must go. However, that
spirituality is just taken up. They are looking and thinking, “We are living in New York, we are living in Paris,
we are living in London.” What is that? For what? If they have such a deep desire for new buildings, there are
endless deserts; go and build your buildings there, as you like your city! Why are you touching Haramayn
Shareefayn? But they are changing every stone and putting another one one it. What is that? Allah will
punish them! Why are you not saying this, Salaafiyoon and no-mind Wahaabiyoon? You are only knowing to
attack on Sunni people, Muslims, Sufi and Dervish people and tariqats. This is tariqat, what I am saying. You
are not on Shari`ah! You are leaving Shari`atullah, khif Allah.
O no-mind People! Just the tajalli `azhaam, the greatest emanations on the night of Laylat ul-Bara`ah, just
Hakam, giving His judgment that everything that is against Islam everywhere will be taken away, Meccatu 'lMukarramah, Madinatu 'l-Munawwarah, and Hijaaz! Yes. You must teach people; you have a heavy
responsibility. Keep your tongues, or `adhaab, punishment, will come on them! Doctors will say, “That is

something that must be taken,” and cutting it. And coming another one, and cutting that. And coming
another, and cutting until there is no tongue for you.
O People! Khif Allah! (Fear Allah!) Keep heavenly orders and don't attack on Muslims; keep your limits!
Hadeeth nabawi ash-shareef: (Mawlana Shaykh stands)
••• •••• •••• ••• ••• • ••• ••••
Rahim Allah imrin `arifa haddahu waqafa `indah, May Allah grant mercy to a man who knows his limits and
stops at it.
Hadeeth ash-shareef! You must try to know what your limits are. They are passing away and you can be shot
down. (Mawlana Shaykh sits) May Allah forgive us. Astaghfirullah.
Fatihah
(45 minutes) (761 people) Alhamdulillah. Yaa Rabbee, shukr.
(Mawlana Shaykh prays two raka`ats Salaat ash-Shukr)
Fatihah.
